stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 6.

There is an explosion of sound and color—cut to a space-age city of apartment buildings perched on columns high in the air.

What is the most likely reason the author uses sensory language in the sentence?

options.label: A
options.text: To imply that the fantastic world presented in The Jetsons led to some real technological innovations

options.label: B
options.text: To reveal how The Jetsons captured its audience’s attention with an exciting vision of the future

options.label: C
options.text: To demonstrate why members of the Baby Boom generation have a nostalgic appreciation for The Jetsons

options.label: D
options.text: To highlight that The Jetsons was more forward-looking for its time than other shows on television
